title: ToolDiff
description: `GET /sessions/:sessionId/tools/:toolUseId/diff`: the diff of one tool call of a live session — of what it did, or, while its permission request is pending, of what it would do, the disk now against the disk with the change applied (plan 28, B-17). Served for a call whose `changes` write one file; any other is `422 DIFF_NOT_APPLICABLE`. One side may be unknown, and the answer says which and why rather than inventing it.

kind.description: The kind of the call — `file.edit` or `file.write`.

pending.description: The call is still waiting for an answer: `before` is the disk now, `after` the disk with the change applied.

scope.description: `file` — the hunks are of the whole file, before against after; `edit` — they are of the strings the call replaces, because one side of the file is not known.

before.description: What is known of the file before the call.

reason.description: Why it is not known: on `unavailable`, `laterTouch` (an earlier write of the same turn reached the file) or `noSnapshot`; on `notRestorable`, `tooLarge` or `unreadable`.

after.description: What is known of the file after the call — or after it would run.

reason.description: Why it is not known, on `unavailable`: the session wrote the file again (`laterWrite`), somebody else did (`changedSince`), or — pending — a replacement would not apply, its text not there (`editMissing`) or there more than once (`editAmbiguous`).

edit.description: Which replacement would not apply, from 0 — on `editMissing` and `editAmbiguous`.

id.description: Names the hunk for a rejection; the same texts give the same ids.

oldStart.description: The first line of the hunk on the old side, from 1 — or where it inserts.
